d: Jordan tries comedy as a way of overcoming stage fright  Vanessa makes a documentary about her home life.
Despite Bernie's offer to buy him a car, Wanda's father cannot get along with him  showing when they all met.
Bernie realizes he may have been too truthful when telling Jordan about his father  he amends the truth to make Jordan think well of his father.
Bernie volunteers as a teacher's helper to assess the teaching methods used at Bryana's school  Wanda is at wits' end trying to reason with Vanessa and Jordan.
The family goes to San Diego for a relaxing vacation  Bernie, unable to relax, goes to Las Vegas for some gambling and debauchery.
A motorcycle accident changes Bernie's perspective about protecting the kids  Jordan is caught trying to sell Bernie's girlie magazines to other boys at school.
Neighbor Carl Reiner (guest starring as himself) plays the ultimate practical joke on Bernie. Ashton Kutcher guest stars as himself.
Dr. Phil McGraw counsels Bernie on how to deal with Wanda, who feels left out after Bernie and the guys draft a woman (Mo'Nique) into their group.
Bernie stops by the Playboy Mansion to get advice from Hugh Hefner on how to talk to Jordan about sex.
"American Idol" judges Paula Abdul and Randy Jackson critique Bernie's commercial.
Bernie and Wanda seek a child therapist's help in figuring out why Bryana has become a bully  Wanda winds up caring for a guinea pig Bernie bought for Bryana.
On Bernie's 40th birthday, he is electrically shocked by an old lady and forced to be a clown at a children's party.
Bernie has to put his foot down after Mr. Diggs, Vanessa's teacher, persuades her to become a vegetarian.
